home.metaDescription: The first SForum foundation includes Nuxt, Go Fiber, Docker Compose, and Simplified Chinese as the default multilingual baseline.
home.title: A maintainable forum starts with a clear foundation.
home.intro: This first slice wires the frontend, backend, health checks, localization, and development/deployment entry points before forum features are added.

auth.registerIntro: The first registered user becomes the protected super administrator. Later users join the member group by default.
auth.loginIntro: Public forum access and admin access use the same account system. API permissions remain authoritative.

home.title: Manage forum groups and permissions
home.intro: Admin tools use the same forum account system, with every management action controlled by API permissions.

roles.title: User Groups
roles.intro: Open registrations join the member group by default. The member alias can change, but the role cannot be deleted.
